audience: R&D and lab teams that keep DNA sequences, notebook entries and folders in Benchling

useCases.title: Find DNA sequences in a project or registry
useCases.text: List the projects of the tenant, then list the DNA sequences of one project or registry. Open one sequence to read its bases.

useCases.title: Review notebook entries changed this week
useCases.text: List the notebook entries of a project, filtered by modification time. Open one entry to read its details.

useCases.title: Look up a teammate's profile
useCases.text: List the teams and users of the tenant. Open one user to read the profile.

useCases.title: Check the folders of a project
useCases.text: List the folders, filtered by project or parent folder. Open one folder to read its details.

useCases.title: Create a folder for new plasmid maps
useCases.text: Open the parent folder to confirm its id. Then create a new folder inside it. Existing records stay unchanged.
